q: In Malachi, what does the LORD say He does not do?
why: So Jacob's descendants were not destroyed.
quote: Because I, the LORD, do not change

q: In Malachi, what did God tell the people to bring into the storehouse?
why: God promised to pour out blessing.
quote: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house.

q: In Malachi, what will God open to pour out blessing?
quote: See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.

q: In Malachi, which prophet will God send before the Day of the LORD?
why: Jesus said John the Baptist came in this role.
quote: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.

q: In Malachi, how did God say the people were robbing Him?
why: They held back what was His.

q: In Malachi, whom will God send to prepare the way before Him?
why: Then the Lord would come to His temple.
quote: Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me.

q: In Malachi, Elijah will turn the hearts of fathers to whom?
quote: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children

q: In Malachi, what will rise with healing in its wings?
why: For those who fear God's name.
quote: the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings

q: In Malachi, those who fear God's name will leap like what?
quote: and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
